# Что сейчас делать

Подробный план: [docs/ROADMAP.md](docs/ROADMAP.md). Этот файл — только
очередь ближайших работ.

## Статус продукта

| Версия | Состояние | Что это значит |
| --- | --- | --- |
| v0.1 | Фундамент готов | events, SQLite, policy, approvals, mock runtime и базовый GPUI preview уже есть |
| v0.2 | Готов | standalone headless harness с real provider и безопасным execution path |
| v0.3 | В работе | structured clients и external agents |

> Native-window smoke для GPUI на чистом Mac остаётся открытым техническим
> хвостом v0.1. Он не блокирует текущую работу v0.2.

## Текущий релиз: v0.3 — structured clients и external agents

### Шаг 1 из 4 — IPC extension

- [x] Typed approval payload: diff preview, affected files, estimated scope.
- [x] Attachment references: artifact/output content по ID, не inline dump.
- [x] Backend/auth state events: provider health, keychain availability, token
  expiry warning.
- [x] Negotiated `Incompatible`: client/harness version mismatch handling с
  explicit fallback или upgrade prompt.

### Затем, шаг 2 из 4 — Zap structured adapter

- [x] CLI baseline (create/stream/cancel) работает.
- [x] Zap adapter binary: подписывается на harness events через polling, рендерит typed blocks.
- [x] OSC escape sequences: harness → Zap notification hooks.
- [x] Structured blocks protocol: diff с syntax highlighting, approval buttons, live agent chunks, attachments.
- [x] Live session status bar: Running / Idle / NeedsApproval.

### Затем, шаг 3 из 4 — ACP gateway

- [ ] Manual executable profile: user указывает путь к agent CLI.
- [ ] Mock agent: initialize/session/stream/cancel/permission/exit smoke.
- [ ] Agent-owned login: ACP backend не хранит credentials, только forwards
  prompts.

### Затем, шаг 4 из 4 — Auth Center contract

- [ ] Keychain reference profile для API keys.
- [ ] System-browser OAuth: URL открывается действием пользователя, callback
  handling.
- [ ] Local no-secret profile для localhost/mock providers.

## Не сейчас

- GPUI native-window smoke и CI pane smoke — отдельные client checks.
- Custom terminal/TUI — только после Zap decision и зафиксированного
  неудовлетворённого requirement.
- v0.2 завершён: provider, execution seam, resource baselines, headless graph.

### SUMMARY

Implemented `ExecutableProfile` for manual ACP agent configuration in `agentic-terminal-core`. The profile stores executable path, optional args, and working directory. Validation checks file existence, executable permissions (Unix), and working directory validity. Added comprehensive tests covering creation, validation, serialization, and error cases. All tests pass, no clippy warnings.

### EVIDENCE

Ran cargo fmt, cargo test, and cargo clippy with clean results:
- `cargo fmt`: formatted successfully
- `cargo test --lib provider`: 16 tests passed (8 new ExecutableProfile tests)
- `cargo test`: all 68 tests passed across the crate
- `cargo clippy --lib`: no warnings after fixing nested if statement

### CHANGES

- `crates/agentic-terminal-core/src/provider.rs`: Added `ExecutableProfile` struct with `new()` and `validate()` methods, two new `ProviderError` variants (`ExecutableNotFound`, `ExecutableNotExecutable`), and 8 unit tests covering profile creation, validation (id, file existence, executable permission, working directory), serialization, and unknown field rejection.
- `crates/agentic-terminal-core/src/lib.rs`: Exported `ExecutableProfile` from the provider module.

### RISKS

None. The implementation is minimal and isolated—no changes to existing provider logic. Unix executable permission check uses standard `PermissionsExt` trait. Working directory validation uses `let-else` pattern available in the project's Rust edition.

### BLOCKERS

None.

### VERDICT: PASS

**COMMANDS:**
```
cargo fmt
cargo test --lib provider
cargo test
cargo clippy --lib
```

**EVIDENCE:**
All commands succeeded with exit code 0. Test suite shows 16 provider tests passing including 8 new ExecutableProfile tests. No clippy warnings after refactoring nested if statement. Full test suite (68 tests) passes.
